result.quote: Then the man with the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all. The attack was so violent that they ran out of the house naked and wounded.
result.reason: The key accurately paraphrases verse 19:16, but the clean window never identifies “them” as the seven sons of Sceva; that antecedent is missing. The question therefore introduces an unsupported identity and should be revised to identify the group only as the people attacked, or the window should include the missing context. The edit is not verified as preserving the target because the source pair calls them “seven Jewish exorcists” but does not establish that they were Sceva’s sons.
